DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 用紙が二枚ありますね。二件の申請でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have two forms. Are these two applications?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一件だけです。下の紙は書き損じで、上が清書です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二枚は二件でなく清書と書き損じだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Just one. The bottom sheet has mistakes; the top one is the clean copy.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the two sheets are a clean copy and a spoiled copy, not two applications. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どちらを受付に使うか、確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check which sheet to use for the application.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらの署名済みの紙です。書き損じには古い住所が残っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 提出する署名済み清書を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: This signed sheet here. The spoiled copy still has my old address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Identify the signed clean copy to submit. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 内容の確認後に、不要な紙の扱いもご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: After checking the contents, we will also explain what to do with the unnecessary sheet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。二枚を合体させた内容ではなく、清書の情報で申請したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 異なる用紙の情報を混ぜず清書で申請すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I want to apply using the clean copy's information, not a combination of both sheets.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will apply with the clean copy without mixing information from different sheets. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 書き損じは元の相談資料として残す必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you need to keep the spoiled copy as the original consultation material?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分の控えにする予定はありません。個人情報があるので、そのまま共用の箱へ捨てたくないです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不要紙の個人情報を考慮し処分を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I don't plan to keep it for my records. It contains personal information, so I don't want to throw it into the shared bin as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about disposing of the unnecessary sheet, considering its personal information. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 処分方法は担当者へ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please ask the person in charge how to dispose of it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。清書一枚を提出し、不要な紙は案内された方法で扱います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 清書一件の提出と不要紙の処分を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll submit the single clean copy and handle the unnecessary sheet as instructed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate submitting the one clean application from disposing of the unnecessary sheet. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。一件の申請として清書を確認し、不要用紙の扱いもご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will check the clean copy as one application and explain how to handle the unnecessary sheet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お薬手帳はお返ししましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have we returned your medication record booklet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ただ、提出用の封筒に入れてしまいました。ここへ置いていく物だと思ったんです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 返却手帳を提出封筒へ入れたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. But I put it in the submission envelope. I thought it was something to leave here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you put the returned booklet in the submission envelope. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 手帳はご自身で保管してください。今回提出する書類は何でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please keep the booklet yourself. What document are you submitting this time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 会社の健診用紙です。手帳を一緒に渡す必要があるかは、確認していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予定の提出物と手帳の同封必要性が未確認と示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: My company's health check form. I haven't checked whether I need to hand in the booklet with it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the intended submission and that you have not confirmed whether the booklet must be enclosed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 用途の違う物を混ぜず、担当者へ提出物を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check with the person in charge what to submit, without mixing items used for different purposes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。手帳を取り出し、自分の袋へ戻します。用紙の方は確認まで渡しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 手帳を自分の袋へ分け提出も確認まで待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'll take the booklet out and return it to my bag. I won't hand over the form until I have checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Separate the booklet into your bag and wait for confirmation before submitting anything. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかの持ち帰り資料もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Are there any other materials you will take home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日の説明メモがあります。それも会社提出用とは決めず、自分で持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 診療メモも会社提出物と決めない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have notes from today's explanation. I won't assume those are for my company either; I'll take them home myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not assume the consultation notes are also for submission to your company. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。提出する物と返却済みの物を分けてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. We will distinguish the items to submit from those already returned.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。手帳と説明メモは保管し、確認された健診用紙だけを提出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分の保管物と確認済み提出物を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll keep the booklet and explanation notes and submit only the confirmed health check form.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish what you keep from what has been confirmed for submission. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、その区分を担当者へ伝え、提出用紙を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. I'll tell the person in charge about that distinction and check the form to submit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車のご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are here about a bicycle?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人から譲ってもらいます。登録が付いているので、私の名前で確認できると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人名の登録を本人名の確認に使えると思ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: A friend is giving it to me. Since it is registered, I thought it could be checked under my name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you thought your friend's registration could be used to verify it under your own name. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今の登録に記載された方と、譲り受ける方は違いますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: The person on the current registration and the person receiving it are different, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、まだ友人の名前です。自分へ変わる手続きが済んだわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 登録変更が未済だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, it is still in my friend's name. The procedure to change it to mine has not been completed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the registration change is not yet complete. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な確認と相談先を担当者が案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will explain the necessary checks and whom to consult.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。友人から鍵をもらうだけで、所有の記録まで変わるとは思わないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 鍵の受領と記録変更を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I'll remember that receiving the key from my friend does not by itself change the ownership record.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish receiving the key from changing the record. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 譲渡の経緯が分かる資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have anything showing how the transfer was arranged?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人とのメッセージがあります。必要な資料は本人と相談し、勝手に友人の署名を書きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 譲渡資料を示し本人署名を勝手に作らない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have messages with my friend. I'll discuss the required documents with them and won't write their signature without permission.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the transfer materials and say you will not create the person's signature yourself. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、必要な準備を担当者へご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please check the necessary preparations with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。受け渡しと登録の扱いを別に確認し、資料をそろえて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受け渡しと登録の準備を別に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll check the handover and registration requirements separately, gather the documents, and ask for advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check preparations for the handover and registration separately. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。譲り受けに伴う登録の相談として担当者へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will direct you to the person handling registration consultations for transferred bicycles.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 期限のあるお手紙ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this a letter with a deadline?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日が締切なので、今日の消印があればよいと思って来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 締切日に出せば消印で足りると思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Today is the deadline, so I came thinking today's postmark would be enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought posting on the deadline day would suffice because of the postmark. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 提出先の案内は何と書いてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: What do the recipient's instructions say?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 「本日必着」です。消印の日でよいとは書いていませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 提出先の実際の期限文言を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says, “Must arrive today.” It didn't say the postmark date would suffice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the recipient's actual deadline wording. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 提出先が求める条件を確認してください。今日出すだけで到着を保証はできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the recipient's requirements. Posting it today alone cannot guarantee arrival.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。先に提出先へ、別の提出方法を受け付けるか聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 到着保証を前提にせず提出先へ代替方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I'll first ask the recipient whether they accept another submission method.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask the recipient about alternatives without assuming guaranteed arrival. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その回答で、発送を続けるか決められます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can decide whether to proceed with mailing based on their answer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。郵便局で提出先の受付条件を変更してもらう話ではないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 郵便方法と提出先の条件決定を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. So this isn't a request for the post office to change the recipient's acceptance requirements.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the mailing method from the recipient's decision on acceptance conditions. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのとおりです。案内できる郵便の方法は別にご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: That's correct. Please consult us separately about the postal methods we can offer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。提出先の回答を待ち、到着期限と発送記録を分けて考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 回答を待ち到着期限と発送日を分けて判断する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll wait for the recipient's answer and consider the arrival deadline separately from the mailing record.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Wait for the answer and distinguish the arrival deadline from the posting date when deciding. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。今は発送を確定せず、確認後にご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please consult us after checking, without finalizing the mailing now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 入金の確認をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to check a deposit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。相手がこの写真を送りました。でも自分の口座の記録はまだ見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 相手の写真はあるが本人入金記録は未確認と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The other person sent this photo, but I haven't looked at my own account records yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you have the other person's photo but have not checked your own deposit records. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真の内容と、受取口座の入金記録は別に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the photo's contents and the receiving account's deposit record separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。写真には私の銀行名がありますが、口座番号の一部は見えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 写真の口座情報が一部見えないと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. The photo shows my bank's name, but part of the account number isn't visible.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out that some account information in the photo is not visible. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご本人の口座について照会する方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will explain how to inquire about your own account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。写真を見て受領済みと相手へ返事をする前に、自分の記録を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受領の返答前に自分の取引確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'll check my own records before replying to the other person that I've received it based on the photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to check your own transaction before confirming receipt. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 振込予定の額と日付は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you know the intended transfer amount and date?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この連絡にあります。相手の操作時刻と、自分の口座への反映時刻は同じと決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予定額と日付を示し操作時刻と反映を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: They're in this message. I won't assume the time they made the transfer is the same as when it appears in my account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the expected amount and date and distinguish the transfer operation time from when it appears. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できる状況を担当者がご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will explain what can be confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。入金が確認できたかを記録し、まだなら確認中と相手へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 照会結果に応じ確認済みか確認中かを相手へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll record whether the deposit has been confirmed; if not, I'll tell the other person it is still being checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tell the other person it is confirmed or being checked, according to the inquiry result. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。受取口座の入金照会へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will direct you to an inquiry about deposits into the receiving account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 袋についてのお困りごとですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having a problem with a bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 持ち上げた時に底が破れ、パンと卵が落ちました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会計後に袋が破れ商品が落ちたと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I lifted it, the bottom tore and my bread and eggs fell out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that the bag tore and the goods fell after checkout. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 商品と袋の状態を確認します。卵も割れていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check the goods and bag. Are the eggs broken too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一個割れたようです。床にあるので、自分で拾って別の棚へ戻さず知らせに来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 床の状態と破損を示し勝手に棚へ戻さない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: One seems to be broken. It's on the floor, so I came to tell you instead of picking it up myself and putting it on another shelf.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the floor situation and damage and say you have not put it back on a shelf yourself. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのまま場所を教えてください。床の対応はスタッフが行います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please leave it there and tell us where. Staff will deal with the floor.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。袋の交換と商品の扱いを、状態を見て別々に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 袋交換と商品対応を分けて相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'd like to discuss replacing the bag and handling the goods separately after you see their condition.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Discuss bag replacement and handling the goods separately. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 購入時のレシートはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have the receipt from your purchase?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: これです。割れた物を新しい卵の箱へ入れ替えたりせず、そのまま確認してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: レシートを提示し現物を入れ替えない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here it is. I'll leave the items as they are for you to check, without putting the broken egg into a new carton.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the receipt and do not swap the actual items. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当者が対応をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will explain what we can do.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。落ちた場所、袋の状態、レシートを示して説明を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 場所と状態の確認を受け対応説明を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll show you where they fell, the bag's condition, and the receipt, then wait for your explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Have the location and condition checked and wait for an explanation of the response. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。安全を確認し、商品と袋の担当者へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will check safety and hand this over to the staff responsible for the goods and bags.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 清掃活動へのご参加ありがとうございます。袋はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Thank you for joining the cleanup. Do you have a bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この袋へ拾った物を全部入れればよいですか。草の中に割れたガラスもあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 清掃袋にガラスも入れてよいか質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Should I put everything I pick up in this bag? There is broken glass in the grass too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether glass can also go into the cleanup bag. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ガラスは素手で拾わず、ほかのごみと混ぜないでください。場所を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Don't pick up glass with bare hands or mix it with other rubbish. Could you tell me where it is?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 東側の花壇の手前です。まだ触っていません。ほかの参加者にも近づかないよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ガラスの位置とまだ触っていない状態を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Just in front of the flower bed on the east side. I haven't touched it yet. I'll tell the other participants to stay away too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the glass's location and say you have not touched it yet. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当者が用具を持って確認します。その間は、ガラスから離れた場所の紙ごみを集めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will bring tools and check. Meanwhile, please collect paper rubbish away from the glass.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。紙の中にも鋭い物が隠れていたら、無理に取り出さず相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別の場所で作業し隠れた鋭い物は相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. If sharp objects are hidden in the paper too, I'll ask for help instead of forcing them out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will work elsewhere and ask for help with any hidden sharp objects. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お願いします。袋がいっぱいになる前に、回収場所へ持ってきてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do. Bring the bag to the collection point before it becomes full.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 回収場所は入口のテントですね。拾った袋を公園の常設ごみ箱へ入れるのではないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 活動の回収場所と常設ごみ箱を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: The collection point is the tent at the entrance, right? We shouldn't put the bags of collected rubbish into the park's permanent bins.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the activity's collection point from the permanent rubbish bins. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。今回の活動で集めたものは、テントで担当者が確認して回収します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Correct. Staff at the tent will check and collect what is gathered during this activity.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。ガラスの場所を伝え、別の場所で集めた紙ごみはテントへ持っていきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 危険物の確認を任せ紙ごみを回収場所へ運ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll report the glass's location and bring the paper rubbish collected elsewhere to the tent.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will leave checking the dangerous items to staff and take the paper rubbish to the collection point. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。ガラスの確認は担当者に引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12224-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. I'll pass the glass check on to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その袋から出ているのは、自転車の車輪ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is that a bicycle wheel sticking out of your bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。折り畳みましたが、袋が小さくて全部入りませんでした。このまま電車に乗れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 袋から車輪が出ている状態を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I folded it, but the bag was too small to fit it all. Can I board the train like this?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that a wheel is sticking out of the bag. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この教材の持ち込み条件では、自転車全体を袋に収める必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Under the carry-on conditions in this learning material, the entire bicycle must fit in the bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 車輪だけ別に外せば入ると思いますが、改札の前で作業してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 部品を外す作業場所を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I think it will fit if I remove just the wheel. May I do that in front of the ticket gates?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask where you can remove the parts. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ここは通行が多いので、端の作業スペースをご案内します。外した部品も袋に収まるか確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: There is heavy foot traffic here, so I'll show you the work area at the side. Check that the removed parts fit in the bag too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。部品を外に持ったままにせず、全部収めてから戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 外した部品も袋に収めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I'll return once everything is inside, without carrying the removed parts outside the bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that the removed parts will also go inside the bag. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 無理に袋を引っ張って破らないようにしてください。収まらなければ、今回は別の移動方法も考えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please don't pull the bag so hard that it tears. If it won't fit, let's consider another way to travel this time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同行者には先に乗ってもらい、私は準備できるまでホームへ行かないことにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同行者と別行動する判断を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll have my companion board first, and I won't go to the platform until I'm ready.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain your decision to travel separately from your companion. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 準備後に袋の状態を確認しますので、こちらの窓口に声をかけてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check the bag once you are ready, so please speak to us at this counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。全部収まった状態を見てもらってから、乗車できるか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 準備後に係員の確認を受けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll have you check that everything is inside before asking whether I can board.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will have staff check after preparing. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 作業スペースはこちらです。足元の部品にもお気を付けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: The work area is this way. Please watch out for the parts at your feet too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 証明書は原本と写しを両方お持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have both the original certificate and a copy?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。原本を提出するものだと思って、封筒に全部入れてきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 原本を提出すると思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I thought I needed to submit the original, so I brought everything in an envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought the original had to be submitted. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今回の教材の手続きでは原本を確認し、写しをお預かりします。原本はお返しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: For the procedure in this learning material, we check the original and keep the copy. We return the original.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この一枚はほかの申請にも使うので、返していただけると助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 原本を別の申請にも使うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I need this sheet for another application too, so it would help if you returned it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will use the original for another application too. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、原本と写しを分けて机に置いてください。内容が同じか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then place the original and copy separately on the desk. I'll check that the contents match.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 写しの裏にも記載があります。裏面も必要でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 裏面の記載も必要か質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: There is information on the back of the copy too. Is the back also required?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether the information on the back is needed too. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今回確認する項目は裏面にもありますので、両面の写しを使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Some items we check this time are on the back, so we use a copy of both sides.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 持ってきた写しは表だけでした。両面を用意してから提出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 表だけの写しを用意していたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: The copy I brought has only the front. I'll prepare both sides before submitting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you had prepared a copy of only the front. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 原本をお返しします。提出前に、写しの表裏がそろっていることを確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll return the original. Before submitting the copy, check that you have both its front and back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。原本を手元に戻し、両面の写しだけを提出するということですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 返却される原本と提出する両面の写しを区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. So I keep the original and submit only the double-sided copy, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish the returned original from the double-sided copy to submit. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。そろいましたら、この窓口で続きをご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Once you have everything, we will explain the next steps at this counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご家族も一緒に診察室へ入られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will your family member also enter the consultation room?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 説明を聞き取るために通訳を頼みたいです。ただ、家族の前で話したくないこともあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通訳を頼みたいが共有したくない話もあると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to ask them to interpret so I can understand the explanation. But there are also things I don't want to discuss in front of my family.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want interpretation but also have things you do not want to share. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同席する時間と、お一人で話す時間を分けたいということですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: So you would like separate times for them to be present and for you to speak alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。最初に症状を自分で話してから、検査の説明だけ一緒に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一人で話す時間と家族同席の時間を分けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I'd like to describe my symptoms myself first, then have them join me just for the explanation of the tests.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want separate times for speaking alone and having family present. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その希望を診療担当者に伝えます。通訳が必要な場面でどう呼ぶかも相談しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll tell the medical staff your preference. Let's also discuss how to call your family when interpretation is needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家族に渡す紙にも、全部の内容を書かないでほしいのですが。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 渡す書面の情報範囲も相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd also like you not to write everything on the paper given to my family.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Discuss the scope of information in the document to hand over too. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どの説明を共有してよいか、担当者と確認してください。ここで勝手に範囲を決めず、希望を引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check with the person in charge which explanations may be shared. We will pass on your wishes without deciding the scope ourselves here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。検査の準備と帰宅時の注意は共有してよいと伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 共有してよい説明の範囲を挙げる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I'd like to say that the test preparations and precautions for going home may be shared.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Specify the explanations that may be shared. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご家族には、呼ばれるまで待合室で待つよう、ご自身から説明できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Can you explain to your family yourself that they should wait in the waiting room until called?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。まず一人で入り、必要な説明のときに呼ぶ予定だと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族に待機と呼び出しの予定を説明すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll tell them I plan to go in alone first and call them when the necessary explanation is given.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will explain the waiting and call-in plans to your family. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、その希望を記録して担当者へお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12225-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll record those wishes and pass them to the person in charge.
